snippet.title: The Shadow Syndicate - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Unravel a dark conspiracy in The Shadow Syndicate, a noir stealth-action game set in 1930s Brooklyn. Use supernatural powers, uncover secrets, and strike from the shadows. Coming soon to PC and consoles.

Music by:

Ignacio Ramirez
Ryota Sasaki
